objective: Stop S6 from issuing unauthorized incident-detail reads and hide incident-detail navigation from OPERATOR while preserving canonical run truth.
requirement_gap: DOC-C permits GET /api/runs/:id to OWNER/OPERATOR/AUDITOR but GET /api/incidents/:id only to OWNER/AUDITOR. Current S6 automatically fetches incident detail whenever a run is FREEZE and exposes OPEN INCIDENT to all run viewers, causing OPERATOR to issue a deterministic unauthorized request and see an unusable CTA.
authority: DOC-C §4.2 GET /api/runs/:id RBAC OWNER / OPERATOR / AUDITOR
DOC-D UI truth and permission visibility law
success_invariants: OPERATOR run views do not issue /api/incidents/:id reads
OPEN INCIDENT is offered only to OWNER/AUDITOR
OWNER/AUDITOR still obtain incident detail for FREEZE summary
run detail remains available to OWNER/OPERATOR/AUDITOR
